rationale: Both candidates independently caught several real, overlapping issues (num_cards=1/2-device fixture mismatch, core_model/H100 marker collision, dropped TP=2 diffusion coverage, unrelated red AMD check), giving each solid grounded precision. But the ground-truth reviewer concerns center on whether the level-2 wake/501 contract is genuinely tested versus just mock-authored/mismatched — X only 'validates' this as already-fine in a non-actionable bullet and never raises the coverage-gap theme, while Y explicitly verifies the 501 mapping end-to-end and raises a well-reasoned blocking finding that the real engine-level #4473 regression test was dropped to weekly-only, directly engaging the same underlying worry as the human P1/P2 comments. Y also surfaces a high-value, well-evidenced bug X entirely misses (the merged diffusion test's VRAM assertions are vacuous because they measure the wrong process), and its remediation steps are more concrete. X's review is solid but has a redundant duplicate finding (items 1/2) and stays more surface-level on the core contract-testing question.
